title: I Would Draw Nearer to Jesus

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Bb]I would draw [F7/Eb]nearer to [Dm]Jesus, [Cm]In [F7/C]His sweet presence abide,
[Dm]Constantly trying to serve [Gm/Bb]Him, Safe [Cm]and secure at His side.
[Bb]I would draw [Dm]nearer to [F7/Eb]Jesus, [Cm]I would draw nearer to [F7]Him;

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Dm]Knowing He loves to be [Gm/Bb]gracious, [Cm]I would draw nearer to [F]Him.
[Bb]I would draw [Dm]nearer to [F7/Eb]Jesus, [Cm]I would draw nearer to [F7]Him;

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Bb]I would draw [F7/Eb]nearer to [Dm]Jesus, [Cm]Seeking [F7]Hi strength to be [Bb]true,
[Dm]Willing to tell of His [Gm/Bb]goodness, [Cm]Gladly His blest will to [F]do.
[Bb]I would draw [Dm]nearer to [F7/Eb]Jesus, [Cm]I would draw nearer to [F7]Him;
